text: While Cow chewed her cud peacefully and Hare rested his twitching whiskers, Hyena tossed and turned in his den.
The scent of roasted groundnuts danced in his dreams like mischievous fireflies.
In the pitch black of midnight, he crept toward the granary.
Rather than break the front lock, he pried open a side reed slat, stuffed his muzzle inside, and gorged himself on groundnuts until his belly bulged like a water gourd.
For three successive nights, the grain level shrank by half, yet Hyena was the first each morning to wail loudly about mysterious thieves.
